title: AI-driven opportunistic screening for carotid atheroma calcification on dental radiographs.
summary: FastViT classified panoramic dental radiographs for carotid atheroma calcification; screening covered 19,205 records, with accuracy and recall around 0.88 on a 694-image analytical dataset. This is imaging detection, not confirmed cardiovascular diagnosis.
ai_technology: FastViT classifies panoramic dental radiographs for carotid atheroma calcification and localizes positive findings.
